name: Special San Dieguito Water District Meeting - 4:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Special San Dieguito Water District Meeting - 4:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 8, 2023 -
04:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL - San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
AGENDA ITEM
1.
Presentation of Financial Plan and Briefing on Budget Based Tiered Rates for the San Dieguito Water District's Water Rate Cost of Service Study. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
1) Review and discuss the long-range financial plan for the District's currently on-going Water Cost of Service Study; 2) Discuss Budget Based Tiered Rates for possible inclusion in future Cost of Service studies; and 3) Provide direction to staff on the financial plan and inclusion of Budget Based Tiered Rates in future Cost of Service Studies.
2023-11-08 Special SDWD Meeting Item #01 - Water Rate Cost of Service Workshop
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
